files.panel_index.csv: panel content and compact/full calculation mapping
files.full_recompute_inputs.csv: relative-path inputs for a full model-based calculation

equivalence.png: The packaged raster is the same exported page payload used by the current Word figure.
equivalence.pdf: The default generated PDF places that raster on the same A4 page. It preserves page appearance and scientific labels, but not the source PDF's vector objects or selectable text.
equivalence.vector_pdf: The portable vector script requires the external formal base inputs and changes only the three registered label areas.
